rules.spec_quote: areset is positive edge triggered asynchronous reseting the Lemming machine to walk left
Lemmings can be in one of two states: walking left (walk_left is 1) or walking right (walk_right is 1)
when ground=0, the Lemming will fall and say ""aaah!""
it starts digging when dig=1
it will splatter and cease walking, falling, or digging (all 4 outputs become 0), forever

rules.condition: in WALK_LEFT/WALK_RIGHT: ground=0 -> fall (same dir, bump ignored); else dig=1 -> dig (same dir); else bump_left=1 or bump_right=1 (including both=1) -> switch direction (toggle)
rules.spec_quote: fall has higher precedence than dig, which has higher precedence than switching directions

rules.condition: in FALL_LEFT/FALL_RIGHT: bump and dig inputs ignored (including on ground=1 cycle); ground=1 -> resume walk same dir (splat if fell >20 cycles); else stay falling
rules.spec_quote: When the ground reappears (ground=1), the Lemming will resume walking in the same direction as before the fall

rules.condition: in DIG_LEFT/DIG_RIGHT: ground=0 -> fall (same dir); else stay digging
rules.spec_quote: will continue digging until it reaches the other side (ground=0). At that point, since there is no ground, it will fall

rules.condition: in FALL_*: ground=1 and fall duration > 20 cycles -> SPLAT; fall duration counts full cycles spent in FALL_* state (cycle ground goes low does not count; splat when duration reaches 21)
rules.spec_quote: if a Lemming falls for more than 20 clock cycles then hits the ground, it will splatter

reset.name: areset
reset.first_released_cycle: first posedge clk after areset returns to 0

before.mid: Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.

uncertain.note: No upper limit on fall length; splat only occurs on the cycle ground=1 is sampled while in FALL_*; mid-air never splats.
candidates: fall duration counts full FALL_* cycles; splat when duration reaches 21 on ground=1
fall duration counts cycles including entry cycle; splat when duration reaches 21 on ground=1
